fields.Name: C2 -> S4.5
fields.Description: Gate G2.8 (phase 2, dataset C2, criterion S4.5): dummy, one-feature and GLM baselines are stored with 95% intervals on C2, 3 of 3; the gate decision is `keep-simple-baseline`, and with shuffled labels `no-signal`, both as in the reference. A pytest node over the trainer (tests/gates/test_evaluation_score_gates.py::test_C2_S4_5_baselines_with_intervals_and_outcomes): the stored outcome equals the sidecar's here, because guards only demote model and a differing sidecar decision is refused; the shuffled-label variant exists only in-process. It fails when the sidecar's baselines return no interval (stored baselines with intervals < 3 of 3).

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Three baselines scored with 95% intervals; keep-simple-baseline (the GLM, equal to the reference's), and no-signal on shuffled labels (1 of 1 pytest case).
